integrity: Integral unit-pivot computations and elementary collapses are reproducible using bundled Python standard-library source; the homotopy step invokes Alexander duality, Hurewicz and Whitehead. No external independent verification has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The statement concerns only the ordinary three-cut complex of the sixteen-vertex Shrikhande graph; it does not classify all strongly regular graphs, other cut sizes, or group representations. Priority beyond inspected sources is not established.
title: The ordinary three-cut complex of the Shrikhande graph is a wedge of eleven eleven-spheres
